import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:luxo_client/luxo_client.dart';
import 'package:http/http.dart' as http;
import 'package:http/testing.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';
import 'client.dart';
import 'types.dart';

void main() {
 test('closed sum requests retain defaults, selection and typed payloads', () async {
  final driver=Platform.environment['LUXO_SEALED_HTTP_CONSUMER'];
  final capture=Platform.environment['LUXO_SEALED_CAPTURE'];
  final scratch=Directory('.tmp')..createSync(recursive:true);
  final own=scratch.createTempSync('sealed-go-');
  addTearDown(() { own.deleteSync(recursive:true); });
  final raw=<List<int>>[
   [1,4,0,1,14,0],[2,10,6,1,6,102,97,105,108,101,100,0],[3,2,0,0],[4,6,0,1,0,2,0,0],
   [4,19,0,1,1,6,1,4,0,1,14,0,2,1,1,4,3,2,0,0,0],[1,2,0,0],[0],[0],
  ];
  final outputs=<Object?>[
   {'Success':{'value':7}},{'Failure':{'reason':'failed'}},{'Pending':{}},
   {'Nested':{'child':null,'history':null}},
   {'Nested':{'child':{'Success':{'value':7}},'history':[{'Pending':{}}]}},
   {'Success':{}},null,[],
  ];
  var sent=0;
  for(final mode in [TransportMode.json,TransportMode.binary]) {
   final transport=HttpTransport('http://sealed.fixture.invalid',options:TransportOptions(mode:mode),client:MockClient((request) async {
    final index=sent++%8;
    final input=mode==TransportMode.json
     ? {'mode':'json','request':jsonDecode(request.body)}
     : {'mode':'binary','bytes':request.bodyBytes.toList()};
    if(driver==null) return mode==TransportMode.json
     ? http.Response(jsonEncode({'data':outputs[index]}),200)
     : http.Response.bytes(raw[index],200);
    final file=File('${own.path}/request.jsonl')..writeAsStringSync('${jsonEncode(input)}\n');
    final process=await Process.run(driver,[file.absolute.path]);
    expect(process.exitCode,0,reason:process.stderr.toString());
    final response=jsonDecode(process.stdout.toString()) as Map<String,dynamic>;
    if(capture!=null) File(capture).writeAsStringSync('${jsonEncode({'request':input,'response':response})}\n',mode:FileMode.append);
    expect(response['status'],200,reason:response.toString());
    return mode==TransportMode.json
     ? http.Response(jsonEncode(response['json']),200)
     : http.Response.bytes((response['bytes'] as List).cast<int>(),200);
   }));
   final client=LuxoClient(transport);
   try {
    final seven=LuxoInt64.fromInt(7);
    final success=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Success(value:seven));
    if(success is Outcome$Success$1) { expect(success.value.value,seven); }
    else { fail('expected success'); }
    final failure=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Failure());
    if(failure is Outcome$Failure$2) { expect(failure.reason.value,'failed'); }
    else { fail('expected failure'); }
    final pending=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Pending());
    expect(pending is Outcome$Pending$3,isTrue);
    final defaults=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Nested());
    if(defaults is Outcome$Nested$4) {
     expect(defaults.child.value==null,isTrue);
     expect(defaults.history.value==null,isTrue);
    } else { fail('expected nested defaults'); }
    final nested=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Nested(
     child:LuxoOptional<OutcomeInput>.present(OutcomeInput.Success(value:seven)),
     history:LuxoOptional<List<OutcomeInput>>.present([OutcomeInput.Pending()])));
    if(nested is Outcome$Nested$4) {
     final child=nested.child.value;
     if(child is Outcome$Success$1) { expect(child.value.value,seven); }
     else { fail('expected child success'); }
     expect(nested.history.value?.length,1);
     expect(nested.history.value?.first is Outcome$Pending$3,isTrue);
    } else { fail('expected nested present'); }
    final tagOnly=await client.echo(value:OutcomeInput.Success(value:seven),select:'Success');
    if(tagOnly is Outcome$Success$1) { expect(tagOnly.value.isSelected,isFalse); }
    else { fail('expected tag-only success'); }
    expect(await client.echoEmpty(value:null),isNull);
    expect((await client.echoEmptyList(values:[])).length,0);
   } finally { client.close(); }
  }
  expect(sent,16);
 });
}
